gen-nixie-one-gf-lato: Nostalgic and a little retro-tech, Nixie One draws hairline-thin letters with open curves, while Lato supplies a sturdier sans-serif underneath. The two sit together easily.
gen-nixie-one-gf-libre-franklin: Libre Franklin has a splayed c terminal and a businesslike manner. Nixie One is best at delicate, uniform-stroke display lettering, while Libre Franklin is best at carrying the actual text with some weight.
gen-nixie-one-gf-livvic: Livvic reads friendly and unfussy, its curves free of stress and its c opening generously, under the thin lines of Nixie One. A long stretch of text would go down smoothly.
gen-nixie-one-gf-lunasima: Lunasima keeps the tips of its c well apart, giving the body text a contemporary, tidy look under Nixie One's untapered display lines. Together they make a crisp, light page.
gen-nixie-one-gf-m-plus-1: Retro lettering meets open-eyed text. Nixie One's thin, constant strokes sit over M PLUS 1, whose e and a have big open eyes, a flat fineliner line on paper. And the clearest quality they share is that generous openness, so every curve breathes.
gen-nixie-one-gf-m-plus-1p: Nostalgic in feel, Nixie One ends every stroke at one measured thickness, with open curves and clear gaps. And M PLUS 1p does the heavier lifting for text, keeping each curve end open and the reading smooth.
gen-nixie-one-gf-m-plus-2: M PLUS 2 has a gaping c opening and one fixed nib width, which gives body text an approachable, professional footing under Nixie One. Larger sizes suit the heading best.
gen-nixie-one-gf-m-plus-code-latin: Approachable and clean, M PLUS Code Latin bends neon tubing into letters. Shrink Nixie One down to small sizes and its hairline strokes will fade, while M PLUS Code Latin stays readable with its wide, pitcher-mouthed c shapes even when set large.
gen-nixie-one-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c: Nixie One's most striking trait is a single stroke thickness from top to baseline, with no shift from heavy to light. M PLUS Rounded 1c follows with terminals that stop short of curling back in, giving the text a soft, approachable finish.
gen-nixie-one-gf-mandali: Nixie One brings a nostalgic, retro-tech feel, with open curves and no quill-like tapering anywhere in its lines. Mandali's generous entry into the e makes the strongest partner.
